name: Vastness Kuukyo no Ikenie-tachi
original_name: ヴァーストニス 空虚の生贄達
source:
Vastness consists of three mini-stories unrelated to each other. The first follows the sexual escapades of a female student who seduces her schoolmates; the second mainly focuses on a treatment of a particular kind received by a man from a female doctor and nurse in a hospital; the third tells the story of a young girl who discovers her sexuality and eventually gets married.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/vastness-kkyo-no-ikenietachi]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
《ヴァーストニス 空虚の生贄達》由三个互不关联的短篇故事组成：第一篇讲述一名女学生四处勾引同校同学的风流韵事；第二篇主要聚焦于一名男子在医院里接受女医生与女护士“特殊治疗”的经历；第三篇则讲述一名年轻少女探索自身情欲并最终步入婚姻殿堂的故事。

[摘自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/vastness-kkyo-no-ikenietachi]Mobygames[/url]]
